description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the Acknowledgements interface, managing collections of acknowledgement objects, their associated entity IDs, status codes, headers, and providing JSON serialization. It handles operations like filtering acknowledgements based on success, timeout, and failure, as well as constructing JSON representations for inter-component communication.

classes.name: ImmutableAcknowledgements
classes.description: Immutable implementation of Acknowledgements, managing acknowledgement objects, their status, headers, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableAcknowledgements instance from a collection of acknowledgements and headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableAcknowledgements instance from entity ID, acknowledgements, status code, and headers.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates an empty acknowledgements instance for a specific entity ID and headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the entity ID from a collection of acknowledgements, ensuring all are compatible.

methods.name: getCombinedStatusCode
methods.description: Determines the overall status code based on individual acknowledgements.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code representing the acknowledgement collection.

methods.name: getMissingAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Returns labels for acknowledgements that timed out.

methods.name: getSuccessfulAcknowledgements
methods.description: Returns all acknowledgements marked as successful.

methods.name: getFailedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Returns all acknowledgements that failed.

methods.name: getAcknowledgement
methods.description: Finds an acknowledgement by its label.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over acknowledgements.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of acknowledgements.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no acknowledgements.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream of acknowledgements.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns headers associated with the acknowledgements.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the acknowledgements.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the type of the entity.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string of the acknowledgements.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the acknowledgement entities as JSON based on schema version.

methods.name: acknowledgementsEntitiesToJson
methods.description: Converts acknowledgements to JSON for serialization.

methods.name: buildHeadersJson
methods.description: Builds JSON representation of headers, considering Ditto protocol specifics.

methods.name: acknowledgementsToJsonWithDisambiguation
methods.description: Creates a JSON object of acknowledgements, grouping by label with disambiguation.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the acknowledgements instance to JSON.
